result.summary: The page is mostly intact. The main issue is a truncated restaurant name in the fastest-delivery carousel, plus a minor inconsistency between the promo headline and the promo code.

issues.description: The restaurant name under the third card in the "Fastest near you" row appears truncated and misspelled as "Trattoria Piccol", unlike the complete names of the neighboring listings.
issues.suggestion: Use the full restaurant name and ensure text truncation handles names gracefully, for example by wrapping to a second line or applying a clear ellipsis.

issues.description: The promo code reads "TALLINN3" with three digits, while the headline promises "3 free deliveries", creating an inconsistency between the code and the offer.
issues.suggestion: Verify the promo code and make sure it matches the stated number of free deliveries.
